title: Tensor-total extension comparison preserving nonnegative summand coordinates
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field] and A,B natural-number-indexed cochain complexes of k-vector spaces. Write E for extension by zero along ℕ→ℤ and Tot for the total tensor complex [def-sp-double-complex-total]. There exists a cochain map e:Tot(EA⊗EB)→E(Tot(A⊗B)). For every p,q≥0 and x∈Aᵖ,y∈Bᑫ, include E(x)⊗E(y) in the (p,q) summand, apply e in degree p+q, then identify the extended natural total term with its original term. The result is the (p,q) inclusion of x⊗y in Tot(A⊗B). No schemes, covers, cup map or coefficient naturality are present.

source.place: Tag 012Z, Definition of the associated total complex and its differential; official page https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/012Z read; direct extension-by-zero specialization.

proof.text: Construct the degree-n map for n≥0 by coproduct descent on integer bidegrees. If both indices are nonnegative, use their extension isomorphisms and the natural-index summand inclusion. If one is negative, use zero. In negative total degrees use zero, since every integer summand has a negative index.

The tensor of the two extension isomorphisms commutes separately with the horizontal and vertical differentials, by extend_d_eq and tensor morphism composition. Expand the total differential after each summand inclusion. The integer sign agrees with the natural sign, so the two terms agree separately. For the boundary from a negative total degree to zero the source is zero. These maps therefore form a cochain map.
The summand equation of coproduct descent and the inverse identities of the extension isomorphisms give precisely the pure-tensor coordinate identity. Degree zero and zero complexes are included.

theorem tensorTotalExtend_coordinates
    {k : Type w} [Field k] (A B : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{w} k) ℕ) :
    ∃ e : mapBifunctor (A.extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)
        (B.extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⟶
      (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k))
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat,
      ∀ (p q : ℕ) (x : A.X p) (y : B.X q),
        ((mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k))
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).extendXIso ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat
            (show ((p + q : ℕ) : ℤ) = ((p + q : ℕ) : ℤ) from rfl)).hom
          (e.f ((p + q : ℕ) : ℤ)
            (ιMapBifunctor (A.extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)
              (B.extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k))
                (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (p : ℤ) (q : ℤ) ((p + q : ℕ) : ℤ) (by
                  change (p : ℤ) + (q : ℤ) = ((p + q : ℕ) : ℤ)
                  omega)
                (((A.extendXIso ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat
                  (show (p : ℤ) = (p : ℤ) from rfl)).inv x) ⊗ₜ[k]
                  ((B.extendXIso ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat
                    (show (q : ℤ) = (q : ℤ) from rfl)).inv y)))) =
          ιMapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{w} k))
            (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p q (p + q) rfl (x ⊗ₜ[k] y)
